name: postern
description: A webmail client for Stalwart, built on JMAP.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c web/e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p jmap/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p web --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p dev && tsc -p web/e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:conventions && npm run contrast && npm test
scripts.check:conventions: knip && depcruise web/src jmap/src && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-base-ui.mjs && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-structure.mjs
